lists.content:
• Become a leader in options market-making, while being recognized and compensated for your contributions within the firm.  
  • Participate in formal education on quantitative concepts to build your trading knowledge. 
  • Lead market-making and execution across commodity options products, guiding pricing, risk parameters, and strategic direction. 
  • Own and refine trading strategies from ideation through execution, generating insights in high-volume and high-volatility markets. 
  • Identify trends and mispricings by leveraging data, market structure knowledge, and an understanding of supply–demand dynamics across commodities. 
  • Collaborate with technologists and quants to enhance analytics, improve models, and systematize trading workflows that scale. 
  • Develop tools to analyze positional opportunities, evaluate risk, and improve options liquidity. 
  • Manage risk with discipline, monitoring exposures in real time and ensuring adherence to Belvedere’s risk philosophy. 
  • Work cross-functionally with research, technology, and trading teams to drive innovation and support the continued evolution of our commodities options trading groups.

• 3–7+ years of experience trading commodity options (energy, metals, agriculture, or related markets). 
  • Demonstrated success generating PnL, managing complex risk profiles, and navigating fast-moving markets. 
  • Deep understanding of options pricing, volatility dynamics, and commodity market structure, including fundamental drivers. 
  • Proficiency with analytical and programming tools such as Python, R, or SQL, with the ability to work with large datasets and improve modeling or decision-support systems. 
  • Ability to thoughtfully approach decision-making, thrive under pressure and adapt quickly to changing market conditions. 
  • Excellent communication skills and a team-oriented mindset. 
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Finance, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, or a related technical field.

Belvedere Trading is a leading proprietary trading firm. We are a team driven by intellectual curiosity, seeking answers that will change not only how we trade in this technological age, but also the future landscape of the trading industry.

Join the pulse of the trading floor at Belvedere Trading, where tradition and innovation converge in the dynamic environment of the AMEX trading floor. As a Floor Trader, you’ll play a critical role in providing liquidity and driving performance in the open outcry marketplace. 

At Belvedere, we’ve built our success on a foundation of intellectual curiosity and continuous improvement. From developing proprietary technology to refining our trading strategies, we are committed to staying at the forefront of the industry. Our traders work seamlessly with our technology teams to optimize models and enhance performance, ensuring we remain agile in an ever-evolving market landscape. 

We are seeking a seasoned professional with expertise in single stock equity volatility and a background in open outcry or voice/chat market making. This role offers the opportunity to apply your market insights and decision-making skills in a fast-paced environment where every trade makes an impact. Experience on the MIAX Sapphire floor or a comparable options trading floor is strongly preferred, particularly in environments that support large, complex orders and combine proprietary technology with open outcry price discovery.

description:
Belvedere Trading is a leading proprietary trading firm proudly headquartered in downtown Chicago. Our traders work hard to provide liquidity to the market through their market-making activities and are the masters of a diverse set of commodities, interest rates, exchange-traded funds (ETF), and equity index options. From the beginning, we began iteratively investing in our proprietary technology and committing to building our systems from the ground up. Our trading models and software systems are continually re-engineered, optimized, and maintained to stay on top of the industry. This wouldn’t be possible without the dedicated efforts of our technology teams who utilize and perfect our innovative technology solutions. 
 
High-performance proprietary development is the source of our success and competitive advantage at Belvedere, further fueling our passion for performance. We are a team driven by intellectual curiosity, seeking answers that will change not only how we trade in this technological age, but also the future landscape of the trading industry. We place a high premium on defining, developing, and deploying high-performance trading software using a team-based, holistic development approach. We look for passionate team members that excel and their contribution is critical to our continued success. 

Belvedere Trading is looking for an FPGA Developer to supplement the team and drive projects that will optimize our options market marking systems. Successful candidates will have a proven track record of success delivering complex FPGA systems on a chip design, possess excellent problem-solving abilities, possess a can-do/self-driven attitude, and have the ability to thrive in a collaborative, entrepreneurial environment.   

The ideal candidate is a creative thinker who has had previous experience developing networks, exchange encoding/decoding, and custom logic on the card. Exchange protocol encoding/decoding experience is desirable.  Additional experience developing hybrid hardware/software systems communicating over PCIe is also desirable.  The successful candidate will direct their own learning, grow their expertise, and pass that knowledge on to other team members.

lists.content:
• Drive People analytics end to end: define the metric set, build the reporting infrastructure, and deliver the headcount, hiring, turnover, and performance reporting leaders use. 

  • Supply and pressure-test the people data behind key workforce questions across the employee lifecycle, and work with the People Partners to turn it into recommendations leaders can act on. 

  • Own the People Operations side of the HRIS and internal Portal, including configuration, access, integrations, and data hygiene. 

  • Lead compensation market intelligence and benchmarking, test bands and guidelines against market movement, and partner with the People Partner to model costs and recommend compensation actions. 

  • Manage the performance review program from design through completion reporting and run the promotion/leveling cycle with the analysis behind it. 

  • Run offboarding end to end, coordinating across People, legal, and payroll, and turn exit data into retention insight. 

  • Automate manual work and continuously improve how People processes run. 

  • Support the broader employee lifecycle alongside the People Operations team, including onboarding, benefits and leave, and day-to-day employee questions.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to translate data into recommendations People partners and leaders can act on. 

  • Able to run multiple concurrent workstreams (analytics, comp, performance cycle, offboarding)

description:
Belvedere Trading is a leading proprietary trading firm proudly headquartered in downtown Chicago. Our traders work hard to provide liquidity to the market through their market-making activities and are the masters of a diverse set of commodities, interest rates, exchange-traded funds (ETF), and equity index options. From the beginning, we began iteratively investing in our proprietary technology and committing to building our systems from the ground up. Our trading models and software systems are continually re-engineered, optimized, and maintained to stay on top of the industry. This wouldn’t be possible without the dedicated efforts of our technology teams who utilize and perfect our innovative technology solutions. 
 
High-performance proprietary trading and development is the source of our success and competitive advantage at Belvedere, further fueling our passion for performance. We are a team driven by intellectual curiosity, seeking answers that will change not only how we trade in this technological age, but also the future landscape of the trading industry.

At Belvedere Trading, Quantitative Traders are some of the industry’s most quantitative problem solvers. We created this unique role to foster collaboration across our proprietary technology and trading teams. As a result, our Quantitative Traders are at the forefront of technology immersion as they learn best practices in software development. Quantitative Traders also implement the most sophisticated trading strategies and focus on projects related to trading logic development, electronic trading strategies, and quantitative research. If you love technology and financial markets, then this position might be for you.

lists.content:
• Daily trading activities – Assist with order execution, trade checking and trade reconciliations 

  • Desk strategy – Participate in strategy meetings and collaborate with your team on their position management 

  • Development projects – Lead and participate in specific quantitative development projects that enhance trader facing technologies 

  • Research – Participate in quantitative research and the application of quantitative strategies while learning concepts behind our core market making operations 

  • Data Analysis – Perform analyses on large data sets and pull insights to support our trading strategies 

  • Training – Engage in continuous, hands-on training that includes education on option valuation, game theory, hedging, portfolio analysis, and simulated trading games to quickly learn the aspects of option pricing and financial engineering, both on a theoretical level and in application with Belvedere’s various strategies 

  • Collaborate –  Partner with teammates to exchange ideas, solve problems, and contribute to a high-performing team environment

• Communication – We need people who can speak confidently and concisely, especially when the stakes are high 

  • Analytical – We’re looking for quantitative thinkers and master problem-solvers with strong data analysis skills 

  • Team Player – Trading and development are not isolated activities at Belvedere, so great candidates will have demonstrated success in working in team-based environments 

  • Core development skills – You will need some training or a demonstrated ability to learn programming languages such as C++, C#, and Python 

  • AI Fluency – Effectively use AI tools to improve efficiency and effectiveness while maintaining independent judgement

  • Knowledge of the financial markets and trading industry is a plus, but not a prerequisite  

  • Ability to live in or relocate to Chicago 

  • Graduation date of December 2026-Spring 2027

lists.content:
• Work with the Technology and Platform business heads to set the people strategy for those organizations, translating engineering roadmaps and departmental goals into action across hiring, engagement, development, performance, and retention. 

  • Lead organizational design for a large, complex technical organization: assess team structures, spans of control, reporting lines, and role definitions, and recommend changes that support scale without adding unnecessary layers. 

  • Own workforce planning at scale, building multi-quarter headcount plans by team and skill set, modeling growth scenarios, and pressure-testing plans against budget and delivery commitments. 

  • Build and maintain leveling and career frameworks for technical roles, ensuring consistent expectations for individual contributors and managers across engineering, infrastructure, and platform teams. 

  • Partner closely with Talent Acquisition on high-volume and specialized technical hiring, setting priorities around headcount sequencing, hiring timelines, role requirements, and candidate experience. 

  • Scale onboarding and ramp-up for technical hires, ensuring a smooth transition from offer through full integration, including compliance, systems access, technical environment readiness, and cultural immersion. 

  • Hold managers accountable for early talent success, ensuring 30-, 60-, and 90-day milestones are met, development plans are established quickly, and new hires are supported through ramp-up. 

  • Grow the people manager bench by identifying emerging leaders, coaching first-time managers, and partnering with the Talent Development Specialist on manager development, technical leadership, and communication skills. 

  • Define learning priorities for Technology and Platform with the Talent Development Specialist, co-designing role-based development paths and technical onboarding tracks that map to the leveling framework, and reinforcing application of training with managers. 

  • Set and reinforce performance expectations across a large population, guiding managers through goal setting, calibration, performance reviews, feedback cycles, and development planning. 

  • Advise leadership on compensation and rewards for technical talent, including market benchmarking, equity and bonus structures, and retention actions for critical contributors. 

  • Serve as a trusted people leader for the departments, proactively addressing concerns, navigating sensitive issues, managing escalations, and protecting a high-integrity, high-performance culture. 

  • Lead people-side change management for reorganizations, team splits and merges, new platform initiatives, and shifts in operating model, including communication planning and manager enablement.

  • Leverage people data and insights at scale to spot trends, surface risks, and inform leadership decisions related to attrition, performance, engagement, span-of-control, and workforce planning.

• Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, Organizational Psychology, or related field (Master’s or HR certification a plus).   

  • 5+ years of strategic HR Partner role experience. 

  • Proven background in big tech, fintech, or high-growth environments is strongly preferred.   

  • Strong business acumen: ability to understand trading/investment business dynamics, financial incentives, performance pressure, and cultural sensitivities.   

  • Excellent interpersonal communication and influencing skills; ability to build trust and credibility with senior leadership and team members.   

  • Strong conflict resolution, coaching, and employee-relations skills.   

  • Solid knowledge of employment law, compliance, compensation practices, and HR best practices.   

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, manage sensitive/confidential matters, and adapt to changing priorities.   

  • Analytical mindset, with ability to use HR data and metrics to drive decision-making and provide insight to leadership.   

  • Integrity, discretion, professionalism, and deep respect for confidentiality.
